name: Cheryl B. Legare
tagline: Top rated Employment Litigation attorney in Decatur, Georgia
education: Georgia State University College of Law
about: Cheryl B. Legare is an attorney who represents clients in the Decatur, Georgia area. Cheryl Legare is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2014 - 2027. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Cheryl Legare chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. She attended Georgia State University College of Law and graduated in 2002. Cheryl Legare passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 2002.
She represents clients with Employment Litigation: Plaintiff issues in Georgia. She also represents clients with Employment & Labor: Employee and Civil Rights issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Cheryl Legare has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
